description: Start a background run producing a tailored résumé, a cover letter, and an ATS score for one job. Preferred over calling the individual tools when the user wants more than one artifact: it returns immediately and cannot time out. Spends allowance across each requested feature. Returns an application_run_id to poll.

job_id.description: UUID of the job posting to apply to.

resume_id.description: Required here (unlike the single-artifact tools). Call list_my_resumes first.

name: start_apply_with_ai
title: Build a full application kit
